title: Malu's Routine V4
author: Andre Assunção
desc: 7 day split, emphasis on legs; upper body development focused on chest and biceps. Follow the program...

ss.note: Keep your feet low on the pad, allow knees to come to the inside of your shoulders. Point toes slightly out. Don't let your lower back came off the pad, not heels to leave the pad.
Don't skip. KEEP THE MACHINE LOCKED, SAFETY ON.

ex.note: Lean forwards, control the weight. Don't let your knees hyperextend.
Control the weight, maintain good posture.

ex.n: Behind The Back Cable Bicep Curl
ex.note: Control the stretch
Stretch as much as possible, breath in to expand the ribs before extending. Focus on your lats. If you must, you can use do it on a cable.
You can use any attachment, would recommend the rope. Focus on maintaining your arm stable to avoid elbow pain.
You can begin with a 5 minutes warmup (rowing), then ramp up the intensity. Record your time, and try increasing it every week until you can row for 25-30 minutes; then, increase the resistance.
You know what this is for...
Focus on stretching the hamstring, you need to go slow for this. You can use a decline if comfortable.

ss.note: Control the weight, do not bounce on the lower leg. Avoid even touching the lower leg, you can begin with no weight on the bar.
REMEMBER TO KEEP THE MACHINE LOCKED OUT. KEEP THE SAFETY ON.

ex.note: Control the weight, maintain good posture.

ex.n: Behind The Back Cable Bicep Curl
ex.note: Control the stretch
Stretch as much as possible, breath in to expand the ribs before extending. Focus on your lats. If you must, you can use do it on a cable.
You can use any attachment, would recommend the rope. Focus on maintaining your arm stable to avoid elbow pain.
Lean forwards, control the weight. Don't let your knees hyperextend.
Yes...
You can row, cycle, or do the stairs. Focus on actually working your cardio, it's not about the calories.
